fields.title: goal: keep active during pi token-limit compaction
fields.description: When the model returns an exceeded model token limit/context overflow error, pi can auto-compact and retry. Tau goal currently treats context-length errors as fatal and pauses the active goal, which breaks the goal loop even though pi recovered via compaction.
fields.design: Classify token-limit/context-overflow assistant errors as pi-owned recovery. Do not dispatch normal goal continuation or goal retry for that agent_end, but also do not pause the goal. Clear goal-owned retry timers/state and leave the goal active so pi's auto-compaction/retry can continue. Keep non-context deterministic errors paused and retryable provider errors bounded.
fields.acceptance_criteria: A goal remains active after an assistant error message containing exceeded model token limit/context overflow text. The goal adapter sends no tau:goal-continuation or tau:goal-error-retry for that agent_end. Existing retryable provider errors still use bounded retries. Existing non-recoverable errors still pause. Regression tests cover the OpenAI exceeded model token limit message.
